verdict.rationale: Airweave has no documented region selection for its hosted service. However, the docs describe self-hosting: you clone the repo, run ./start.sh and deploy on macOS, Linux or WSL. That puts synced data on infrastructure you choose, which gives indirect control over residency. This matters because the platform keeps its own copy of ingested data rather than just wrapping APIs. missing for 10: region/residency selection in the hosted cloud offering, documented data-residency or storage-location guarantees, production self-hosting guidance beyond a local deploy, independent corroboration.
